title: Constraint: Map Items to N Non-Empty Queues
constraints: Map the items 0 … 9 onto 4 queues `q[0..3]`: each item in exactly one queue, each queue with **2 or 3** items, and items in **ascending** order inside each queue.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Same pattern as the three-queue problem: randomize ownership, then build in `post_randomize()`.
Pushing items in index order keeps every queue sorted for free.
4 queues × 2…3 items must add up to 10, and the solver finds such splits for you.

examples.check: each item 0..9 is in exactly one queue
examples.title: partition

examples.check: items in each queue are in ascending order
